note: Vermont Department of Health retail food inspections, read from the public portal. 'as_of' is the day we checked; 'latest.date' is the day the inspector visited. violations.plain_english: Food was stored in the wrong kind of container or wasn't labeled with what it is (or, for packaged food, missing required label details).
violations.inspector_note: Working container holding food item was not labeled properly to identify contents - label all foods made in the walk-in cooler.

violations.plain_english: Food that spoils fast (meat, dairy, cooked rice, cut produce) was found too warm in the fridge, not hot enough on the line, or cooled too slowly. This is the classic food-poisoning risk.
violations.inspector_note: Written procedures were not maintained or made available to the regulatory authority - individually packaged to go sauce cups noted in Berg 2 door prep line refrigerator at 50-53 F with no time marking or written procedure for time as a control. See attached time as a control document and product moved to walk-in cooler immediately.

violations.plain_english: Food that spoils fast (meat, dairy, cooked rice, cut produce) was found too warm in the fridge, not hot enough on the line, or cooled too slowly. This is the classic food-poisoning risk.
violations.inspector_note: Potentially hazardous food is not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display, service and transport - cooked pork, ready-to-cook potstickers, sweet n sour chicken, chicken fingers, dumplings noted at 46 F in Migali 2 door refrigerator. Made today so had move to walk-in cooler immediately.

violations.plain_english: Food that spoils fast (meat, dairy, cooked rice, cut produce) was found too warm in the fridge, not hot enough on the line, or cooled too slowly. This is the classic food-poisoning risk.
violations.inspector_note: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked - date mark all time/temperature control food(TCS) as no datemarking occurring. See attached datemarking documents.

violations.category: Equipment able to keep food at temperature
violations.plain_english: A cooler, hot-holding unit or other equipment wasn't able to keep food at a safe temperature, or there wasn't enough of it.
violations.inspector_note: Food temperature measuring devices are not provided and/or not readily accessible for use - provide thin mass foods digital probe thermometer for verifying cook, cold hold, and hot hold food temperatures.

violations.category: Equipment able to keep food at temperature
violations.plain_english: A cooler, hot-holding unit or other equipment wasn't able to keep food at a safe temperature, or there wasn't enough of it.
violations.inspector_note: Refrigeration facilities are not conveniently located and/or ineffective to maintain potentially hazardous foods at 41F or less - Berg 2 door prep line refrigerator near ice machine noted at 53 F. Removed all to- go packaged sauces to walk-in cooler. Repair to maintain 41 F or colder.

violations.category: Equipment able to keep food at temperature
violations.plain_english: A cooler, hot-holding unit or other equipment wasn't able to keep food at a safe temperature, or there wasn't enough of it.
violations.inspector_note: Refrigeration facilities are not conveniently located and/or ineffective to maintain potentially hazardous foods at 41F or less - Migali 2 door prep line refrigerator on cook line closest to the dishwash area noted at 46 F. Repair to maintain 41 F or colder.

violations.plain_english: Food wasn't covered or was stored where it could get dirty, such as on the floor, under a dripping pipe, or uncovered in the walk-in.
violations.inspector_note: Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor - numerous food containers/boxes noted on floor of walk-in freezer. Store all foods on shelf or on a dunnage rack in walk- in freezer.

violations.plain_english: Scoops, ladles or tongs in use were stored in a way that could contaminate food, such as with the handle down in the ice or flour.
violations.inspector_note: In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing - numerous knives/cleavers stored in between prep tables and rice scoops stored in room temperature water. Store all cleavers/knives on clean work surface or knife holder in between use and store rice scoops in hot water at 135 F or hotter at all times in between use.

violations.plain_english: Staff working with food weren't wearing clean outer clothing or a hat, hairnet or other hair restraint.
violations.inspector_note: Food employee was observed without proper hair restraint - employee in kitchen noted preparing food with no har restraint. Always wear hair covering while working in kitchen.

violations.plain_english: Surfaces that touch food or ice (cutting boards, ice machines, slicers) were worn, cracked, hard to clean or made of the wrong material.
violations.inspector_note: Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition- numerous portable cutting boards noted deep cuts/worn. Replace or plane off so smooth and cleanable.

violations.plain_english: The kitchen was missing food thermometers, fridge thermometers, or test strips to check that sanitizer is the right strength.
violations.inspector_note: Testing strip or device was not used to accurately measure the concentration of sanitizing solution - chlorine test strips(mechanical dishwasher) expired August 2025 and quaternary ammonium(QAC) 24 25 5-208.24 5-208.25 sanitizer test strips expired December 1, 2025. Obtain new test strips for chlorine and QAC sanitizer. Use daily and/or when change sanitizer container. Equipment and utensil food-contact surfaces are not cleaned with proper methods and/or frequency - ice machine top interior noted with slimy mold accumulation. Clean and maintain. Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment are not cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues - mechanical dishwasher noted with accumulation of food grime accumulation. Clean top and sidewalls of mechanical dishwasher.

violations.plain_english: A smaller restroom or handwashing issue, such as no handwashing sign, no covered trash can in a restroom, or a door that doesn't close.
violations.inspector_note: Employee handwash sign is not placed in each toilet room and handwash sink location where it can be easily viewed and read by employees - no handwash sign posted at bar handsink. Post handwash sign attached to the report.

violations.plain_english: A smaller restroom or handwashing issue, such as no handwashing sign, no covered trash can in a restroom, or a door that doesn't close.
violations.inspector_note: Handwash sink was not supplied with sanitary single-use paper towels or an air hand-drying device - no towels at any of the handsinks in kitchen or bar. Always provide handtowels in dispenser.

violations.plain_english: A smaller restroom or handwashing issue, such as no handwashing sign, no covered trash can in a restroom, or a door that doesn't close.
violations.inspector_note: Handwash sink was not supplied with hand-cleaning soap or hand detergent - no handsoap at any of the kitchen or bar handsink. Provide handsoap in dispenser at all handsinks.

violations.plain_english: Floors were dirty, damaged, or made of a material that's hard to clean.
violations.inspector_note: Proper cleaning methods are not used. Proper floor coverings are not used - clean floors below the sink areas of kitchen.

violations.plain_english: Floors were dirty, damaged, or made of a material that's hard to clean.
violations.inspector_note: Floors are not properly constructed and maintained in good repair - walk-in freezer floor is solid rust. Replace flooring so smooth/cleanable.

violations.plain_english: Floors were dirty, damaged, or made of a material that's hard to clean.
violations.inspector_note: Floors are not properly constructed and maintained in good repair - walk-in cooler floor tiles are chipped/cracked as enter walk-in cooler. Replace/maintain.

violations.plain_english: The hood or exhaust fans weren't working well or were dirty, letting grease, steam or smoke build up.
violations.inspector_note: Toilet rooms are not adequately ventilated - women's restroom vent is inoperable. Repair/replace.
